title: Topic 21
japanese_text: 電車の椅子に<u>堂々と</u><u>股</u>を広げて座り、隣の席にはみ出している人がいる。こうした行為は<u>恥じる</u>べきで、隣の人の迷惑にならないように脚を閉じて座るのが<u>望ましい</u>。
english_translation: Some people sit on train seats with their legs spread proudly, crotch on display, crowding out the seat next to them. They should be ashamed of such behavior. It is preferable to sit with your legs closed to avoid bothering your neighbors.
